species.name: Common Raven
species.region: North America, Europe, Asia and North Africa — Arctic cliffs to desert canyons
species.mark: Long wedge-shaped tail, shaggy throat hackles, deep rolling croak
species.size: Largest of the ravens — wingspan up to about 1.5 m

species.name: Thick-billed Raven
species.mark: Huge, deeply arched bill with a pale tip; white patch on the nape
species.size: Rivals the Common Raven as the heaviest songbird

species.name: White-necked Raven
species.region: Mountains and cliffs of eastern and southern Africa
species.mark: White crescent across the back of the neck; heavy, pale-tipped bill

species.name: Chihuahuan Raven
species.region: Deserts and grasslands of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico
species.mark: Neck feathers are white at the base — seen only when the wind ruffles them

species.name: Brown-necked Raven
species.region: The Sahara, Arabia and the deserts of the Middle East
species.mark: Bronze-brown sheen on the head and neck

species.name: Fan-tailed Raven
species.region: Northeast Africa and the Arabian Peninsula
species.mark: Very short tail and broad wings — looks almost tailless overhead

species.name: Somali Crow
species.mark: Also called the Dwarf Raven; slim bill and small body

species.name: Australian Raven
species.mark: White eyes in adults; long throat hackles puffed out when calling

species.name: Forest Raven
species.region: Tasmania and pockets of southeastern mainland Australia
species.mark: Heavy bill, short tail, deep guttural call

species.name: Little Raven
species.mark: Smaller and more sociable — often seen in flocks
